section_summary.extract_value: This abstract describes a single study investigating body appreciation among men using a British community sample of 439 men (mean age 39.13 years). The study examined correlates of body appreciation and tested whether levels vary across sexual orientation, finding that body appreciation inversely correlated with masculine norms and upward appearance-based social comparisons, and positively correlated with physical activity and body satisfaction.
